svg.title: IndusMind — architecture
svg.desc: IndusMind: Industrial knowledge intelligence · FastAPI · pgvector · Neo4j · React. Plant knowledge is buried in manuals, drawings, shift logs and regulations. IndusMind ingests those documents and lets engineers ask questions in plain language, with answers that cite the exact source passages.
